A1.justification: Both PDFs are complete, readable 25-page versions of G-reasoner, including Appendices A-F. Full-text comparison and rendered-page inspection support reliable comparison of the text, equations, tables and figures.

before.justification: v2 reports original QA, retrieval, generalization, ablation and efficiency results in Section 5, with additional evaluations and case studies in Appendix D.

after.justification: v4 retains the original experimental results in Section 5 and Appendix D, including benchmark comparisons, ablations and efficiency measurements.

M1.justification: The QuadGraph representation, 34M-parameter GFM, training objectives, distributed message passing and LLM integration are unchanged. Deleting a stray equals sign in Equation (8) does not establish a method change.

E1.justification: Both versions retain HotpotQA, MuSiQue, 2Wiki and the three G-bench domains, along with the full MuSiQue evaluation in Appendix D.2. Training-data sources and tested graph-structure scenarios are also unchanged.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged throughout the main and appendix experiments. This includes IRCoT, R1-searcher and Search-R1 in Table 10, and Qwen3-Emb-8B, HippoRAG and GFM-RAG in Table 12.

E3.justification: Sections 5.1, B and C retain the same splits, corpus construction, metrics, model configurations, training budgets and retrieval settings. The additional evaluation protocols in Appendix D are likewise unchanged.

E4.justification: The graph-structure generalization tests, component ablations, larger-corpus analysis, efficiency/scaling analyses and reasoning case studies are identical in both versions, including Tables 4-5 and Appendix D.

E5.justification: Both versions use the same point-estimate reporting. Neither reports experimental seed or repeated-run counts, confidence intervals, error bars or significance tests.

E6.justification: All reported numerical and qualitative results are unchanged. For example, G-reasoner retains HotpotQA EM/F1 of 61.4/76.0 in Table 2 and MuSiQue-Full EM/F1 of 33.64/47.89 in Table 12.

T1.justification: Equation (8) loses an extraneous equals sign immediately after the summation symbol. This is a typesetting correction; its terms, the training objective, mathematical definitions and appendix derivations remain unchanged.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, contribution list and conclusion retain the same claims about unified graph reasoning, the 34M-parameter GFM, scalability, benchmark performance and cross-graph generalization.

C2.justification: Result interpretations and mechanism explanations are unchanged. Appendix F retains the same limitations concerning text-only graphs, separate GFM/LLM modules and the focus on question answering.

D1.justification: Implementation details, hyperparameters, hardware, training time and prompts are unchanged. Both retain the same project link and statement that code and pretrained weights will be released upon acceptance.

R1.justification: The cited works, reference entries and research positioning in Section 2 and Appendix A are unchanged.

P1.justification: v4 removes the acknowledgment of C Gong's NSF of China support and updates the arXiv version/date stamp. Apart from the Equation (8) typesetting correction, the prose, terminology and section organization are unchanged.

P2.justification: Equation (8) is recentered after the stray symbol is removed, and the shortened acknowledgment shifts subsequent text upward on page 11. All seven figures and sixteen tables retain identical content, formatting and placement.

improvement.justification: v4 corrects a stray symbol in Equation (8), removes one funding acknowledgment and updates the version stamp. These limited editorial changes leave the scientific argument, evidence, reproducibility information and appendices unchanged, producing no meaningful net difference in overall paper quality.
